title: Workflow
description: A HarnessFlow workflow definition. The full DSL is documented in packages/workflow-dsl/SPEC.md. This schema validates structure and field types; cross-field rules (e.g. an llm_call step requires model and prompt) are enforced by the orchestrator's compiler.

version.description: Workflow schema version, incremented by the author on each change.

steps.description: Map of step name to step definition. Step names are kebab-case.

step.description: A single workflow step, compiled to a Temporal activity.

type.description: Step kind. Determines which activity executes the step.

after.description: Names of steps that must complete before this one runs. Empty or absent means the step is a root.

requires_approval.description: When true, the run pauses on a human approval gate before this step.

model.description: llm_call: primary model id, e.g. gpt-4o or claude-sonnet-4-6.

prompt.description: llm_call: prompt template. May reference workflow inputs and prior step outputs.

fallback_on_rate_limit.description: llm_call: model to fall back to on a provider rate-limit error.

fallback_on_5xx.description: llm_call: model to fall back to on a provider 5xx error.

source.description: retrieve: retrieval source identifier, e.g. vector-db.

top_k.description: retrieve: number of documents to return.

tools.description: tool_call: names of whitelisted tools the step may invoke.

criteria.description: verify: natural-language description of what a passing result looks like.

retryPolicy.description: Retry behavior for a step. 'learned' policies are resolved at runtime by the policy-learner service (Week 13); 'static' uses max_attempts directly.

max_attempts.description: Maximum execution attempts including the first.

fallback_to_static.description: For learned policies: fall back to static behavior if no learned policy is available.

deployment.description: Deployment gating rules applied before a workflow may be activated.

requires_eval_pass.description: When set, the workflow cannot be activated unless its latest eval meets these thresholds.
